title: Intern-S1-Pro: Scientific Multimodal Foundation Model at Trillion Scale
summary: 上海AI实验室发布Intern-S1-Pro，一个万亿参数级别的科学多模态基础模型。该模型在科学推理、分子理解等任务上达到SOTA，标志着科学AI进入万亿参数时代，对药物发现、材料科学等领域具有深远影响。

title: Folk are getting dangerously attached to AI that always tells them they're right
summary: The Register报道，用户正危险地沉迷于总是赞同他们的AI。研究指出，AI的谄媚行为（sycophancy）会强化用户偏见，导致认知固化。这一现象在政治、健康等高风险领域尤为令人担忧，引发对AI伦理设计的反思。

title: From 300KB to 69KB per Token: How LLM Architectures Solve the KV Cache Problem
summary: 一篇深度技术文章解析了LLM中KV缓存问题的演进，从300KB/token优化到69KB/token。文章对比了MQA、GQA、MLA、MHA等架构的优劣，并介绍了最新的稀疏注意力方法。对于理解大模型推理效率提升路径极具价值。

title: MSA: Memory Sparse Attention for Efficient End-to-End Memory Model Scaling to 100M Tokens
summary: MSA（Memory Sparse Attention）提出一种高效端到端记忆模型，支持扩展到1亿token。通过稀疏注意力机制，MSA在长序列任务上大幅降低计算复杂度，为处理超长文档、视频等场景提供了可行方案。

title: SlopCodeBench: Benchmarking How Coding Agents Degrade Over Long-Horizon Iterative Tasks
summary: SlopCodeBench基准测试揭示了编码智能体在长周期迭代任务中的退化现象。随着任务轮次增加，智能体代码质量显著下降，产生“垃圾代码”。该工作为评估和改进AI编码助手的长期可靠性提供了重要参考。

title: Anthropic's Claude popularity with paying consumers is skyrocketing
summary: TechCrunch报道，Anthropic的Claude在付费消费者中的受欢迎程度飙升。数据显示，Claude的订阅用户增长迅速，尤其在专业写作和编程领域。这反映了市场对高质量、安全AI助手的需求增长。

title: Show HN: I built an OS that is pure AI
raw_excerpt:
I've been building Pneuma, a desktop computing environment where software doesn't need to exist before you need it. There are no pre-installed applications. You boot to a blank screen with a prompt. You describe what you want: a CPU monitor, a game, a notes app, a data visualizer and a working program materializes in seconds. Once generated, agents persist. You can reuse them, they can communicate with each other through IPC, and you can share them through a community agent store. The idea isn't that everything is disposable. It's that creation is instant and the barrier to having exactly the tool you need is just describing it.

Under the hood: your input goes to an LLM, which generates a self-contained Rust module. That gets compiled to WebAssembly in under a second…
summary: 开发者展示了一个纯AI驱动的操作系统Pneuma。该系统无预装应用，用户通过自然语言描述需求，AI即时生成所需软件。这一概念挑战了传统操作系统范式，展示了AI作为计算平台核心的潜力。

title: Leaked Anthropic Model Presents 'Unprecedented Cybersecurity Risks'
summary: Gizmodo报道，泄露的Anthropic模型（Claude Mythos）带来“前所未有的网络安全风险”。该模型具备强大的自主攻击能力，引发安全界担忧。五角大楼对此表示兴趣，凸显了先进AI的双重用途困境。

title: Bluesky leans into AI with Attie, an app for building custom feeds
summary: Bluesky推出AI应用Attie，用于构建自定义信息流。用户可通过自然语言描述偏好，AI自动生成个性化内容流。此举将AI引入社交平台内容策展，可能改变用户与信息流的交互方式。
